https://news.sky.com/story/the-10-most-s.text:
From wildfires in Portugal to the Hong Kong ballet - here are the images of the day chosen by the Sky News picture editors.
Protesters gathered outside the Old Bailey in London where six people have appeared after being charged with aggravated burglary, criminal damage and violent disorder over a Palestine Action protest.
Palestinians wait to receive food from a charity kitchen, in Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip.
A famine has been declared in Gaza City and the surrounding neighbourhoods.
The Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) - a globally recognised system for classifying the severity of food insecurity and malnutrition - has confirmed just four famines since it was established in 2004.
Students of the Don Cossack Cadet School of the Emperor Alexander III undergo military training in the Rostov Region in Russia.
Greta Thunberg, along with several others from Extinction Rebellion, protest inside DNB's office in Oslo."DNB is the Nordic bank that invests the most money in oil and gas, nearly three times more than the runner-up," activist Lea Wiggen said in the statement.
Geon-yeong Lee, In-kyu Bae and Mi-seon Kang get into character as the mischievous dokkaebi from '1457, The Boy at Rest' as they explore the Royal Botanic Garden in Edinburgh. The musical show blends South Korea's folk traditions with modern melodies and is part of the Edinburgh Korean season, in partnership with Assembly, at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe.
Students of the Don Cossack Cadet School of the Emperor Alexander III undergo military training in the Rostov Region, Russia.
People visit the highest point of Serra da Estrela mountain as smoke rises from a wildfire, Guarda district, Portugal.
Surfers ride the waves amid Hurricane Erin in the Atlantic Ocean at Lido Beach, New York.
Local employees in western Japan clear away mud that has flowed from typhoon damage in Minamisatsuma City.
The Hong Kong Ballet perform during a dress rehearsal of 'The Butterfly Lovers' at the Lincoln Center's Koch Theater in New York City.
North Korean leader Kim Jong hugs a soldier as he attends a national commendation ceremony for the commanders and fighters of the Korean People's Army's overseas operations unit.
